convert_dalle_checkpoint: convert a DALL-E checkpoint to a FlavaImageCodebook model and save it to a PyTorch dump folder
upgrade_state_dict: upgrade a DALL-E encoder state dict to match FlavaImageCodebook key naming conventions
count_parameters: count the total parameter values in a PyTorch state dict excluding encoder.embeddings
create_flava_codebook_config: create a FlavaImageCodebookConfig with default or custom pretrained configuration path
run_convert_cli: run the CLI script to convert a DALL-E checkpoint to FlavaImageCodebook format via argparse
